**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The insurance provisions in § 18 sit at (in fact slightly above) the playbook's preferred position:

| Playbook preferred | § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✔ USD 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✔ USD 2,000,000 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | ✔ USD 5,000,000 |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✔ |
| Certificates on request | ✔ (§ 18.2) |

Additional customer-favourable terms worth noting: employer's liability of USD 1M (beyond our ask), coverage maintained for the term plus one year, reputable insurers, cover primary to ours where commercially customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — which protects our position under the liability provisions. Nothing here requires negotiation.
